newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said he was surprised by recent British reports that the Commission was interfering with national political campaigns. He said that was "nonsense".

Van der Pas also said that when talking about the G7 becoming a G4 Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy only put the question of the EMU's external dimension. The G7 will gather whenever the countries want to do so, without the Commission's proposal, he said.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/361: The Commission opens proceedings on aid for Asociacion General Agraria Mallorquina S.A (AGAMA) in Spain.
- IP/97/365: Single market: Commission agrees outline of action plan.
- IP/97/366: Commission adopts action plan for customs transit reform in Europe.
- IP/97/368: The Commission authorises a total of Sterling 891 million in aid to cover the inherited liabilities of the United Kingdom coal industry.
- Eurostat news release No 33/97: Three complementary decisions by Eurostat on accounting rules.
